steps.text: All tests pass. The `unique()` function now preserves first-occurrence order by iterating through the items and only appending items not already in the result list. This approach also works for unhashable items like dicts, since it uses equality comparison (`in`) rather than hashing. The warning is unrelated to the code changes.
